messages:
maddie: heads up — SCIM provisioning to customer 'Arkaline' started failing after last night's RBAC role rename. deprovision API calls returning 403 and audit shows KMS decrypt errors on the service token. anyone on call?

liam: which env? prod or staging?

maddie: prod (tenant arka-19). snippet from scim-svc logs: 
```
ERROR scim-svc Provisioner - 403 deprovision user=4821 tenant=arka-19
Caused by: AWSKMSDecryptionError: Failed to decrypt with key alias/redwood-scim (AccessDeniedException)
RequestId: abc-123-def
```

roshan: KMS AccessDenied typically means the principal no longer has kms:Decrypt on that key. did we change any key policy or IAM role recently? @infra-bot any infra PRs that touched IAM/KMS?

infra-bot: no direct KMS policy edits in last 48h. however the role-rename pipeline ran: infra/iam PR #412 merged ~02:14 UTC (renamed several service roles).

anne: if the role ARN changed, key policy might still reference the old role principal. also check STS assume-role flow for the scim provisioner. role rename can break trust.

liam: can you paste the scim service principal from config?

maddie: config extract: 
```
scim.service_role_arn = "arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/redwood-scim-provisioner"
kms_key_alias = "alias/redwood-scim"
```

roshan: quick hypothesis: role was renamed to redwood-scim-provisioner-v2 and key policy still allows only the original ARN. i'll check IAM now.

infra-bot: the pipeline created new role arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/redwood-scim-provisioner-v2 and removed the old role in staging; prod change intended to be additive but looks like the old principal was removed in prod. investigating.

maddie: mitigation options: 1) add kms:Decrypt to the new principal in key policy (fast), 2) fallback to DB token for scim calls (messy). prefer quick key policy patch to restore flow.

anne: short-term: add explicit key-policy allow for arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/redwood-scim-provisioner-v2 with kms:Decrypt on alias/redwood-scim. long-term: update role-rename playbook to include KMS key policy sync and tests.

liam: i'll open infra ticket and apply key-policy change. @roshan please coordinate and validate decrypt. add audit/rollback plan.

roshan: applying policy change now, will run a scim dry-run and then a deprovision retry.

maddie: note: we also observed RBAC mapping drift — group 'ark-admins' mapping to internal 'admin' got dropped after the rename. separate item but likely from the same pipeline change.

security-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0423. severity: P2. assignees: liam, roshan. audit required for KMS policy change and role rename PR #412.

liam: policy change pushed, testing...

infra-bot: key policy update deployed (change-id f1e2d3).

roshan: test results: scim deprovision call returned 204. KMS decrypt succeeded in provisioner logs.

maddie: customer reports provisioning flows returned to normal. next actions: 1) postmortem 2) update role-rename playbook to include KMS policy verification 3) add alert for spikes of KMS Decrypt AccessDenied.

anne: adding items to security backlog and will own the postmortem template update.

maddie: :thumbsup: thanks all — please attach the postmortem link here when ready and close the incident.
